scripts.check:client: for f in js/*.js js/i18n/*.js sw.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && echo "check:client: ok — $(ls js/*.js js/i18n/*.js sw.js | wc -l | tr -d ' ') scripts parsed"
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run check:client && vitest run
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply QUEUE_DB --config wrangler-api.toml --env="" --local
scripts.db:migrate:production: wrangler d1 migrations apply QUEUE_DB --config wrangler-api.toml --env="" --remote
scripts.db:migrate:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply QUEUE_DB --config wrangler-api.toml --env staging --remote
